study_title: Regorafenib in Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (CONCUR Study)
brief_summary: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center phase III study to evaluate efficacy and safety of regorafenib in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Regorafenib or placebo plus best supportive care (BSC) was administered to patients; endpoints included overall survival, progression-free survival, and safety.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum, metastatic disease, prior standard therapies failed.
exclusion_criteria: Uncontrolled hypertension, recent major surgery, active serious infection.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility based on histology, prior therapies, and organ function.

study_title: A Study of Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab With or Without Chemotherapy for BRAF V600E Mutant Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Evaluates encorafenib plus cetuximab with or without standard chemotherapy in patients with unresectable or metastatic BRAF V600E mutant colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Randomized, multicenter, open-label study comparing progression-free survival and response rates across several arms.
inclusion_criteria: Adults with confirmed unresectable/metastatic BRAF V600E mutant colorectal cancer.
exclusion_criteria: Prior treatment with BRAF or MEK inhibitors, significant comorbidities.

study_title: Phase 3 Study of MRTX849 With Cetuximab vs Standard Chemotherapy in Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Open-label, randomized phase 3 clinical trial comparing efficacy of MRTX849 and cetuximab versus chemotherapy in second-line mCRC.
detailed_description: Patients receive either targeted therapy (MRTX849/cetuximab) or standard chemo; endpoints include survival and response.
inclusion_criteria: KRAS G12C mutation-positive metastatic colorectal cancer; prior first-line therapy.
exclusion_criteria: History of prior KRAS inhibitor therapy.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility as determined by molecular testing and protocol criteria.

study_title: Standard Chemotherapy Plus Surgery Versus Chemotherapy Alone in Stage IV Colorectal Cancer
lead_sponsor_name: European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer
brief_summary: Compares standard chemotherapy plus palliative surgery versus chemotherapy alone for stage IV colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Evaluates whether adding surgical resection to systemic therapy improves survival and quality of life.
inclusion_criteria: Stage IV colorectal cancer with non-resectable metastases.
exclusion_criteria: Active infection, severe comorbidities, unfit for surgery.

study_title: Combination Chemotherapy and Bevacizumab as First-Line Therapy in Treating Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (TRIBE)
brief_summary: This randomized phase III trial compared two combination chemotherapy regimens (FOLFOXIRI + bevacizumab vs FOLFIRI + bevacizumab) as first-line therapy for unresectable, metastatic colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Patients received either FOLFOXIRI (irinotecan, oxaliplatin, leucovorin, fluorouracil, bevacizumab) or FOLFIRI (irinotecan, leucovorin, fluorouracil, bevacizumab) every 2 weeks. Primary outcome measured was progression-free survival; secondary outcomes included safety, overall response rate, secondary R0 surgeries, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed colorectal cancer; unresectable metastatic disease; measurable disease; no prior chemotherapy for metastatic disease; ECOG 0-2 (≤70 years) or 0 (71-75 years); adequate organ function.
exclusion_criteria: Untreated brain metastases; CNS disease by physical exam; significant cardiac or bleeding disorders; pregnancy or nursing; other active malignancies.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility based on histology, prior therapies, organ function, and absence of major comorbidity.

study_title: Identification and Treatment Of Micrometastatic Disease in Stage III Colon Cancer
brief_summary: This study compares two standard of care treatment options based on blood test results for participants who have metastatic colon cancer.
detailed_description: Participants with resected stage III adenocarcinoma are assigned to surveillance or additional therapies, depending on ctDNA status and molecular markers (e.g., MSI-H, BRAF). Treatments may include FOLFIRI, Nivolumab, Encorafenib/Binimetinib/Cetuximab, or Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab.
inclusion_criteria: Resected stage III colon adenocarcinoma, completion of standard adjuvant chemo, ≥18 years, ECOG 0-1, normal organ/marrow function, required molecular testing.
exclusion_criteria: Prior neoadjuvant chemo, metastatic disease, inability to get standard adjuvant therapy, some molecular exclusion for certain arms.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility for each treatment arm determined by ctDNA and molecular status.

study_title: Testing the Addition of Atezolizumab to Combination Chemotherapy or Atezolizumab Alone for Metastatic Colon or Rectal Cancer, the COMMIT Study
brief_summary: Phase III trial tests whether adding atezolizumab to combination chemotherapy improves outcomes in dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Arms include chemotherapy plus bevacizumab, atezolizumab alone, or combination therapy. Outcomes: PFS, overall survival, response rates, and safety profiles.
inclusion_criteria: dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma, no prior therapy for metastatic disease, measurable disease.
exclusion_criteria: Other active malignancy, significant comorbid illness, pregnancy.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility set by molecular tumor status and standard protocol criteria.

study_title: Resection vs no Resection of the Primary in Colorectal Cancer With Unresectable Metastases
conditions: Unresectable Metastasis Originating in Colonic Cancer
brief_summary: Assesses cancer-related survival at 2 years in patients with unresectable metastatic colorectal cancer treated with chemotherapy alone vs primary tumor resection + chemotherapy.
detailed_description: Multicenter randomized clinical trial comparing two therapeutic strategies: chemotherapy alone vs. surgical resection (R0) followed by chemotherapy.
inclusion_criteria: Colorectal cancer ≥12cm from anal verge, unresectable synchronous metastases, ECOG ≤2, no contraindications for chemo.
exclusion_criteria: Rectal tumours <12cm, CNS or bone metastasis, other neoplastic disease in previous 5 years.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility defined by tumor location, metastatic status, and performance status.

study_title: Niraparib and Panitumumab in Patients With Advanced or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (NIPAVect)
brief_summary: Phase II trial studies the side effects and efficacy of niraparib and panitumumab in treating patients with RAS wildtype advanced colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Niraparib is a PARP inhibitor; panitumumab is an EGFR antibody. Trial enrolls previously treated advanced mCRC.
inclusion_criteria: RAS wildtype mCRC, ≥1 prior therapy, ECOG ≤1, organ function, informed consent.
exclusion_criteria: Prior PARP/EGFR inhibitor therapy; uncontrolled medical illness; active infection; untreated brain metastasis.
eligibility_criteria: See protocol—primarily prior therapies, molecular status, and fitness.

study_title: CGX1321 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors and CGX1321 With Pembrolizumab or Encorafenib + Cetuximab in Subjects With Advanced GI Tumors (Keynote 596)
brief_summary: Phase 1/1b study of CGX1321 dose escalation, alone or with pembrolizumab, or with encorafenib/cetuximab (for BRAF V600E mutant CRC).
detailed_description: Design includes monotherapy escalation, combinations for advanced GI cancers, including mCRC; safety and preliminary efficacy endpoints.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced, relapsed, or refractory solid/colorectal/GI tumors, ECOG 0–2, adequate organ function, informed consent.
exclusion_criteria: WNT inhibitor use; prior certain therapies; uncontrolled CNS mets; major recent surgery; serious medical risk.
eligibility_criteria: As per inclusion for particular arms—mCRC with/without BRAF mutations.

study_title: ctDNA as a Prognostic Marker for Postoperative Relapse in Early and Intermediate Stage Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Observational, multicenter prospective trial; investigates circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) as a marker for relapse of colorectal cancer post-surgery.
detailed_description: Utilizes serial ctDNA monitoring and NGS to guide prediction of disease recurrence; aims for improved surveillance beyond standard markers.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed stage II/III CRC, post-surgery, ECOG ≤1, survival >12 months.
exclusion_criteria: Adjuvant treatment before surgery; recent transfusion; HIV/HBV/HCV positive; pregnancy.
eligibility_criteria: Defined by pathological and performance status.

study_title: Initial Attack on Latent Metastasis Using TAS-102 for ct DNA Identified Colorectal Cancer Patients After Curative Resection (ALTAIR)
brief_summary: Randomized, double-blind, multinational Phase III study: tests TAS-102 vs. placebo for patients with positive ctDNA after CRC resection.
detailed_description: Assesses whether preemptive treatment in ctDNA-positive, post-resection CRC prolongs disease-free survival.
inclusion_criteria: Colorectal adenocarcinoma, curative surgery, stage III, positive Signatera ctDNA test, ECOG 0–1, organ function.
exclusion_criteria: Prior TAS-102, more than 1 adjuvant chemo, other active cancer, ongoing serious comorbidity.

study_title: A Phase III Study of Xilonix in Patients With Advanced Colorectal Cancer (XCITE)
brief_summary: Evaluates Xilonix™ (MABp1), a true human monoclonal antibody, for improving survival in refractory metastatic colorectal carcinoma patients.
detailed_description: Randomized, placebo-controlled study in patients refractory to all standard therapies. Focuses on improvement in survival and quality of life by blocking chronic inflammation.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed metastatic or unresectable colorectal carcinoma, refractory to standard regimens, ECOG 0-2, adequate renal/hepatic/bone marrow function.
exclusion_criteria: Mechanical obstruction, major uncontrolled disorders, infection or cardiovascular disease, significant weight loss, immunodeficiency.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility based on cancer refractoriness, organ function, and performance status.

study_title: Panitumumab and RAS, Diagnostically-useful Gene Mutation for mCRC (PARADIGM)
brief_summary: Compares mFOLFOX6 plus panitumumab versus mFOLFOX6 plus bevacizumab as first-line treatment in KRAS/NRAS wild-type, incurable/unresectable, advanced/recurrent colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Randomized study in chemo-naive patients, focusing on RAS wild-type and advanced/unresectable disease. Endpoints: overall survival, progression-free survival.
inclusion_criteria: Aged 20-79, histologically confirmed unresectable adenocarcinoma of colon, KRAS/NRAS wildtype, no prior chemotherapy, measurable disease, adequate organ function.
exclusion_criteria: Radiotherapy within 4 weeks, brain mets, serious comorbidities, active infection, recent surgery.
eligibility_criteria: Eligibility primarily based on RAS status, organ function, and prior therapy.

study_title: Efficacy and Tolerance of Maintenance Therapy in Patients With Incurable Advanced Colorectal Cancer (Confirm Study)
brief_summary: Evaluates cetuximab plus irinotecan or fluorouracil as maintenance therapy after FOLFIRI + cetuximab for RAS wild-type, incurable advanced colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Initial FOLFIRI + cetuximab induction, followed by maintenance with cetuximab/irinotecan or cetuximab/fluorouracil; endpoints include progression-free survival and quality of life.
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed metastatic CRC, measurable disease, RAS wild-type, prior therapy, ECOG ≤2, life expectancy >3 months, organ function.
exclusion_criteria: Pregnancy, CNS disease, other malignancies, major organ dysfunction.
eligibility_criteria: Defined by histology, prior therapy, performance, and organ status.

study_title: NEOadjuvant PembRolizumab In Stratified Medicine - ColoRectal Cancer (NEOPRISM-CRC)
brief_summary: Phase II study: uses pembrolizumab as neoadjuvant in MSI-H/MMR-d and high-risk stage 2/3 unresectable/inoperable colorectal cancer.
detailed_description: Patients stratified by TMB/MSI status; therapy pre-surgery; assesses safety and relapse-free survival for immunotherapy.
inclusion_criteria: Histological adenocarcinoma, MSI-H or MMR-d, high-risk staging, suitable for trial colonoscopy, ECOG 0-1, age ≥18.
exclusion_criteria: Radiotherapy needed, evidence of metastases, prior checkpoint inhibitor or systemic therapy, immunodeficiency.
eligibility_criteria: Defined by molecular status, staging, fitness for treatment.
